overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding the Group violated the OML by late member certifications but not by its handling of two earlier complaints, and declined the appointment-process allegations.

allegations.summary: Group members allegedly did not submit their Open Meeting Law certifications on time.
allegations.key_passage: However, three members of the Group did not submit their signed certifications until September 24 and 25.

allegations.summary: The Group allegedly failed to meet in a timely manner to review two earlier Open Meeting Law complaints.
allegations.key_passage: Since the Group met within the extended time allowed by the Attorney General and authorized Counsel's response to the complaints, we find no violation.

allegations.summary: Allegations that the Select Board appointed only two members and that its motion creating the Group lacked necessary details.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, even if true, these allegations would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.

remedy: Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, all members who have not completed a certification for the Group or the Select Board must do so.
remedy_passage: We order all members who have not completed a certification for the Group or the Select Board to do so within 30 days of receipt of this letter.
